num_items: <int> Number of distinct items to be produced.
num_periods: <int> Number of discrete time periods in the planning horizon.
num_machines: <int> Number of nonidentical machines available in the production facility.
max_machines_per_item_per_period: <list[int], length num_items> Maximum number of machines that may simultaneously produce each item within a single period.
machine_capabilities: <list[list[int]], length num_items> Set of 1-indexed machine identifiers capable of producing each item.
demand: <list[list[int]], shape [num_items][num_periods]> Quantity of each item required in each period.
production_time: <dict, key: 'item_{item}_machine_{machine}'> Time consumed per unit produced for each item on each capable machine.
holding_cost: <list[float], length num_items> Per-unit cost of carrying one unit of each item in inventory for one period.
setup_cost: <dict, key: 'item_{item}_machine_{machine}'> Fixed cost incurred whenever a lot of an item is produced on a capable machine in a period.
setup_time: <dict, key: 'item_{item}_machine_{machine}'> Time consumed by performing a setup for each item on each capable machine in a period.
production_cost: <dict, key: 'item_{item}_machine_{machine}'> Per-unit cost of producing each item on each capable machine.
capacity: <list[list[float]], shape [num_machines][num_periods]> Available production time on each machine in each period.
